[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]] was born to a '''mother''' and [[Dak Ralter's father|father]], [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[prisoners]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Kalist Base|Kalist VI labor colony]].

==Behind the scenes==
The sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' refers generally to the "[[Parent/Legends|parents]]" of Dak Ralter. Although the identities of each parent is not revealed, this article makes a basic biological assumption of mother and father.
